subject: Re: Procurement & Commercial Path — Budget owner mapping for Acme
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@acme.com>, Tom Sokol <tom.sokol@acme.com>, Jane Doe <jane.doe@acme.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Procurement & Commercial Path — Post-call recap and next steps

Hi Emily / Tom / Jane —

Thanks again for taking time this morning. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on procurement and approval routing: 

Call highlights:
- Primary use case: inference for customer-facing search and chat, expected 25-50M tokens/month in Q3.
- Security: SOC 2 in progress, can provide procurement pack and architecture diagram.
- Commercial preference discussed: PO with 30–45 day terms, possible marketplace purchase if available.

Action items / questions for Acme:
1) Can you confirm the budget owner / economic buyer for this engagement? (Name & contact)
2) Who is the finance sponsor who would handle PO issuance and payment terms?
3) Any required legal signatory (title) for contract execution?
4) Is a marketplace (AWS Marketplace) preferred, or do you need a Redwood invoice + PO flow?

Attachments: Redwood-SKUs.pdf (SKU/pricing snapshot), Procurement-Pack.zip (SOC 2 summary, architecture diagram, commercial T&Cs).

Next steps (from Redwood):
- I can share a procurement checklist and sample PO flow by EOD.
- Vivek will prepare a sizing + cost estimate once we have budget owner details.
- Aditya will follow up on marketplace enablement timeline.

Would you be able to confirm the budget owner and finance sponsor by EOD tomorrow so we can get internal approvals queued?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

--
Redwood-SKUs.pdf (attached)

From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@acme.com>, Tom Sokol <tom.sokol@acme.com>
Date: 2026-05-18T10:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement & Commercial Path — Post-call recap and next steps

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. A few quick answers from our side: 
- Budget owner / economic buyer: Emily Zhang, Director of ML Platforms (emily.zhang@acme.com).
- Finance sponsor: Carlos Mendes, Sr. Finance Manager (carlos.mendes@acme.com) — he owns PO issuance and payment terms.
- Signatory: Our Legal team typically requires a VP-level signatory for platform SaaS agreements; likely our VP of Procurement (we'll confirm exact name).
- Preferred commercial path: We prefer to buy via PO with 30 net days. We are evaluating marketplace routes, but Marketplace procurement requires internal approvals and could add ~2 weeks. If you can provide a marketplace listing, that would be helpful, but we can proceed with PO + invoice for speed.

I've attached our PO instructions (PO-instructions.pdf) and copied Carlos on the next thread.

Thanks — happy to join a short call if helpful.

Best,
Jane
Procurement Lead, Acme Corp

Date: 2026-05-18T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement & Commercial Path — Budget owner mapping for Acme (next steps)

Thanks Jane — helpful. Looping Carlos and Emily so we can align on timing and signatory path. A couple of items from Redwood: 

1) Marketplace: We can prioritize getting Redwood listed on AWS Marketplace (or your preferred cloud marketplace). That typically takes 1–2 weeks for onboarding + verification on our side. If speed is critical, we can proceed with PO + invoice while marketplace is parallel.

2) Procurement pack: I'm attaching a short procurement pack (Procurement-Pack.zip) with SOC 2 summary, architecture diagram, sample contract, and a minimal invoice template for PO processing.

3) Contracts & signatory: If your legal needs a VP-level signatory, we can route the contract to our VP of Legal. Would you prefer Redwood to insert a single-signatory clause (company officer) or the full legal exec name?

4) Next meeting: Vivek can run a quick sizing session with Emily to give a detailed cost estimate. Propose Wed 5/20 11am PT — is that workable?

Next steps I will take after confirmation:
- Share a concise proposal (quote + SOW) and onboarding checklist.
- Draft a PO-ready invoice and send to Carlos for review.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround from your team.

Marissa
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

--
Procurement-Pack.zip (attached)

Subject: Re: Procurement & Commercial Path — Budget owner mapping for Acme (sizing request)

Hi Emily / Carlos —

Quick note from the engineering side: once we have final confirmation on expected monthly token volumes (25–50M is a good range) and peak concurrency requirements, I can put together a recommended Dedicated vs Hosted runbook and an estimate for monthly unit costs and uplift for reserved capacity.

Emily — can you share any existing SLA targets or latency requirements you expect for production? Also, if you have a preferred timezone for the sizing call, I can adjust. I'm available Wed 5/20 11am PT as Marissa suggested.

If Carlos prefers, I can include a short appendix in the quote showing both PO invoice flow and Marketplace purchase options (with timing implications).

Thanks — looking forward to the sizing session.

Vivek
